list: Official PSN trophy list: 55 trophies — 1 platinum, 2 gold, 6 silver, 46 bronze; 28 hidden.
about: Official names, descriptions, grades and hidden flags verbatim from the PlayStation list (Exophase / PSNProfiles). Guides, steps, kinds, stages and missable windows are this entry's own words, researched at build time from the named sources beside each trophy; unconfirmed triggers are labelled. The app itself never touches the network.

trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!
trophies.guide: The platinum crowns the other 54: no online or DLC trophies exist, so one single-player run is enough. PowerPyx puts the full list at roughly 200 hours and 4/10 difficulty; the long pole is A Long Road's 100% checklist, which is closer to 60% of true completion. Keep cheats off — they disable trophies and saving.
steps: Finish the story and the 100% checklist (A Long Road).
Mop up Strangers & Freaks and any activity trophies the checklist didn't cover.
The platinum pops with the 54th trophy.

trophies.name: Just Like Paradise
trophies.guide: The first story trophy: it pops after Gone Fishing, the opening main mission of Chapter 1. Automatic and unmissable — this game has no mission gold medals or hidden objectives.
steps: Play the Chapter 1 main mission Gone Fishing.
The trophy unlocks at mission completion.

trophies.name: Paradise Lost
trophies.guide: Despite the name, this unlocks after What's in the Bag?, the first main mission of Chapter 2 — chapter-completion trophies lag one mission into the next chapter. Automatic; with no mission replay, keep a manual save at each chapter boundary (15 slots plus autosave).
steps: Finish Chapter 1's main missions.
Complete What's in the Bag? in Chapter 2 — the trophy pops there.

sources.label: PowerPyx — Trophy Guide & Roadmap
sources.note: pops after What's in the Bag?

trophies.name: T**s Ass Drug Money
trophies.guide: Chapter 2's completion trophy — the name really does carry asterisks on PlayStation. It unlocks after Welcome to Vice City, the first main mission of Chapter 3. Automatic story progress.
steps: Play through Chapter 2 (Breakfast Run, Coffee Break, Daily Driver and Moses are among its main missions).
Complete Welcome to Vice City in Chapter 3 to pop it.

sources.label: PowerPyx — Trophy Guide & Roadmap
sources.note: pops after Welcome to Vice City

trophies.name: Vice City, Baby!
trophies.guide: Pops after the first two Chapter 4 main missions, Ocean Beach and Another Life — not at the Chapter 3 boundary itself. Automatic.
steps: Finish Chapter 3, including The Cartel Heist.
Complete Ocean Beach and Another Life, the first two Chapter 4 missions.

sources.label: PowerPyx — Trophy Guide & Roadmap
sources.note: pops after Ocean Beach & Another Life

trophies.name: Top Of The World, Ma
trophies.guide: Chapter 4's completion trophy unlocks after Starting From Zero, the chapter's final main mission, per PowerPyx's walkthrough mapping. Automatic.
steps: Complete Chapter 4's main missions, ending with Starting From Zero.

trophies.name: You Gotta Know When to Get Off
trophies.guide: The gold story trophy for the final mission. Guides disagree on the exact chapter numbering — PowerPyx maps the finale to Starting From Zero at the end of Chapter 4, while GamesRadar+ lists it under Chapter 5 — but all agree it is the last main mission and unmissable. Free roam continues after the credits, so nothing else locks.
steps: Reach the final main mission (Operation Savage Glory precedes it).
Complete it; free roam opens after the credits for all cleanup.

trophies.name: Trust
trophies.guide: Breakfast Run is a Chapter 2 main mission; the trophy pops during it. Automatic story progress — no optional objectives to watch.
steps: Play Chapter 2.
Complete Breakfast Run.

trophies.name: Break the Bank
trophies.guide: The Cartel Heist is a Chapter 3 main mission; the trophy unlocks during it. Automatic.
steps: Play Chapter 3.
Complete The Cartel Heist.

trophies.name: Family Matters
trophies.guide: Child's Play is a Chapter 4 main mission — PowerPyx's walkthrough titles it 'Rescue Rafa from Kidnappers'. Automatic story trophy.
steps: Play Chapter 4.
Complete Child's Play.

trophies.name: DWNFALL
trophies.guide: Headliners is a Chapter 4 main mission — PowerPyx describes helping with a launch party. Automatic.
steps: Play Chapter 4.
Complete Headliners.

trophies.name: Hi-Jacked
trophies.guide: VCIA Takedown is a Chapter 4 main mission. Automatic — and the same airport later hosts Catch Me If You Can's jet heist.
steps: Play Chapter 4.
Complete VCIA Takedown.

trophies.name: Snow Storm
trophies.guide: Operation Savage Glory is a Chapter 5 main mission per PowerPyx and gta.guide. Automatic story progress on the way to the finale.
steps: Reach Chapter 5.
Complete Operation Savage Glory.

trophies.name: A Long Road
trophies.guide: The 100% checklist appears under Progress > Stats > 100% Completion after the story; everything done earlier counts and nothing toward it is missable. It is lenient — closer to 60% of true completion. Required in full: all 8 bank vaults, all 39 gang operations, all 33 underwater discoveries, all 42 shooting-range golds, all 42 drone races and all 15 of Bret's target decks. Partial targets: 70 of 80 challenges, 300 of 397 stunts, 200 of 277 base-model vehicle scans, 100 of 255 animals studied, 15 of 18 meditations and card sets, 100 optional tasks. Leonida Interactive counts 35 checklist entries.
steps: Finish the story; open Progress > Stats > 100% Completion.
Clear the 'everything' categories: robberies, underwater discoveries, range golds, drone races, Bret's 15 decks.
Fill the partial categories to their targets (70/80 challenges, 300 stunts, 200 vehicles, 100 animals, 100 optional tasks…).
The gold pops at 100%.

trophies.name: Cunning Stunts
trophies.guide: Any 250 of the 397 stunts count, mixed freely across four categories: 130 stunt jumps, 202 under-bridge flights, 40 knife flights and 25 base jumps. Under-bridge flights are the fastest grind. The 100% checklist wants 300, so keep going past the trophy. Track by region under Progress > Activities > Stunts, or by name via Map > Exploration > Stunt Spots.
steps: Pick the category you find easiest — under-bridge flights are quickest.
Perform stunts; each counts once, no challenge medals needed.
At 250 the trophy pops; continue to 300 for 100%.

trophies.name: Master of None
trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.guide: Nine activity types, one taste of each: fishing, hunting, golf, shooting range, pool, basketball (score a hoop), a video game, a race win (car, challenge or drone) and a stunt. The story introduces most automatically; the map's blue activity filter marks the rest. You will almost certainly earn it while working on other trophies.
steps: Open Progress > Activities to see which types are still at zero.
Do one of each missing type — a single basketball hoop counts, and finishing one arcade game counts.
The trophy pops at 9/9.

trophies.name: The Shootist
trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.guide: Gold medals in all 42 shooting-range challenges across 12 ranges. Ranges also raise your Focus level, which makes Gunslinger easier, so do them early. PowerPyx rates the golds as not too difficult and maps every range.
steps: Find the 12 ranges on the map.
Earn gold in every challenge at each range — 42 in all.
The 100% checklist needs the same 42 golds, so this feeds A Long Road.

trophies.name: Top Fun
trophies.description: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.
trophies.guide: Win at least one Top Fun drone race at each of the 14 locations; one win per venue is enough for the trophy. The 100% checklist wants all 42 races (three per venue), so the trophy lands on the way.
steps: Locate the 14 drone venues (PowerPyx maps them all).
Win one race at each venue.
Return for the remaining races when chasing 100%.

trophies.name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos
trophies.guide: Win 20 different races out of the 40 available — winning the same race again adds nothing. The 100% checklist wants 30 of 40 race wins plus 10 of 13 race-challenge golds, so this bronze falls early in the racing sweep.
steps: Filter the map for races.
Win 20 distinct events.
Keep going to 30 wins (and 10 challenge golds) for 100%.

trophies.name: Baited My Tackle
trophies.description: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.
trophies.guide: Cal appears in the Chapter 1 mission Feng Shui; afterwards he texts a fishing spot marked with a purple icon. Follow his fishing questline and beat him in his challenge. Everything stays available after the story.
steps: Complete Feng Shui in Chapter 1 to meet Cal.
Answer his text and visit the marked fishing spot.
Play through his fishing quests until the challenge against Cal — win it.

trophies.name: Stick Fiddler
trophies.guide: Finish all levels of any one of the four in-game video games: Tenebrae Lux, Street Trash III and Time Jackers Rewind play on the home TV (available from Chapter 1), Bang For Your Buck on arcade cabinets around Leonida. You only need to reach the end of one game — not beat its challenges.
steps: Pick a game — the home TV trio is easiest.
Play through every level once.
The trophy pops at the end of any one game.

trophies.name: Road to Rehabilitation
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Andy.
trophies.guide: Andy's questline is Lucia-only: during Chapter 3 she calls, then texts her home address in Belville. Five quests — Climbing the Cellerichain (3 parts), Pay the Cellerica Fee, Peach!, Read the Label and Puff Puff Pass — and the last one pops the trophy. Still available after the story.
steps: Play as Lucia in Chapter 3 and answer Andy's call.
Follow the five Cellerica quests in order.
Complete Puff Puff Pass (the warehouse meet) for the trophy.

trophies.name: This Was No Boat Accident
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Kenton.
trophies.guide: Kenton's treasure-diving strand starts in Chapter 1 after Island Dreams: he marks purple shipwreck icons, you dive and dig treasure with the metal detector, and clear 7 shipwrecks in total across his sets. He goes quiet after Chapter 1 but texts again as Jason in Chapters 2–3 (calling Brian speeds it up) — PowerPyx confirms he is not missable. Track under Progress > Characters > Kenton Rees.
steps: Meet Kenton via Island Dreams in Chapter 1.
Dive his marked wrecks; use the metal detector on the seabed.
When he goes quiet, progress the story as Jason (or call Brian) until he texts again.
Clear all 7 shipwrecks; the final turn-in pops the trophy.

trophies.name: The Lone Rider
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Billy.
trophies.guide: Billy's five jobs start at the Thrillbilly Mudclub in Kelly County after Coffee Break (Chapter 2): Thrillbillies, Twist Wrist Smash Grab, Mall Rats, The Impaler and Hometown Heroes — the fifth pops the trophy. Available after the story.
steps: Complete Coffee Break in Chapter 2.
Visit the Thrillbilly Mudclub and run Billy's five jobs.
Finish Hometown Heroes for the trophy.

trophies.name: Strangers & Freaks
trophies.description: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida.
trophies.guide: Complete 8 open-world stranger strands — but not every contact counts: PowerPyx confirms Kirk (Skunk Ape), Kyle, Yago and Pilot Pete qualify, while Moses, Tyrone, Yasmani, Andy, Billy and Eddie do not. The full qualifying list is still being confirmed, so watch the trophy's own tracker rather than counting contacts. None of it is needed for 100%, and all strangers remain after the story.
steps: Work the confirmed strands: Kirk, Kyle, Yago, Pilot Pete.
Pick up further open-world strangers as you explore.
Check the trophy tracker in the PSN list; at 8 strands it pops.

trophies.name: Supply & Demand
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Randy.
trophies.guide: Randy's Wish List opens after the Chapter 3 mission Clonin' Keys, Makin' GS (which also gives the Key Cloner): deliver 16 specific sports cars to his garage in west Vice City. Scan cars with WAiNK to check the list; he marks some in fixed spots, the rest can be stolen off the street — they cluster around Vice Beach/Ocean Beach hotels. Deliver in good condition for better pay. Track under Map > Robberies > Randy's Wish List.
steps: Complete Clonin' Keys, Makin' GS in Chapter 3.
Scan high-end sports cars with WAiNK; deliver wishlist hits to Randy (green RK icon, west Vice City).
Deliver all 16 — the Zorrusso from the story mission counts.

trophies.name: Spin On This!
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Tyrone.
trophies.guide: Tyrone's strand is Jason-only and opens after Here, Kitty Kitty in Chapter 3: destroy the Kitty Litter synthetic labs marked purple around Vice City (Take Out Kitty Litter), then his second job Spin On This — shutting down the labs — pops the trophy. Available after the story.
steps: Complete Here, Kitty Kitty as Jason in Chapter 3.
Destroy the marked synthetic labs.
Finish Tyrone's final job, Spin On This.

trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude
trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
trophies.guide: Meditate at all 18 spots across 10 locations; doing a spot with both Jason and Lucia counts +2. The catch: the very first meditation — Lucia's invitation on the balcony of Jason's house, one morning in Chapter 1 (PowerPyx saw it after Down to Earth) — vanishes when Chapter 1 ends. It raises the counter but isn't marked as a Meditation Spot, and PowerPyx hasn't confirmed whether the trophy requires it; they had done it when the trophy popped. Do it to be safe. The final spot needs duo mode (after Coffee Break, Chapter 2). For 100% only 15 of 18 are needed.
steps: Ch1 morning: talk to Lucia in the kitchen (after Down to Earth).
Follow her to the balcony; choose Accept — counter +1.
After Coffee Break (Ch2), meditate at all 18 spots; duo = +2.
Track: Progress > Collections > Exploration > Meditations.

missableInfo.window: Chapter 1 only — morning after Down to Earth
missableInfo.pointOfNoReturn: End of Chapter 1: the balcony invitation never returns; no mission replay or New Game+.
missableInfo.why: The first meditation raises the counter but is not a marked spot; PowerPyx hasn’t confirmed the trophy needs it — they had done it when it popped.
missableInfo.safePlay: Accept Lucia’s balcony invite in Chapter 1; keep a manual save before the chapter ends (15 slots).

trophies.name: Fair Game
trophies.description: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.
trophies.guide: Bret Vogel texts Jason (not Lucia) after Coffee Break in Chapter 2, starting Veteran Hunted in Lummox County. He then marks hunting spots purple and requests specific animals; bring them to him as Jason. Which exact animal pops 'unique animal' is still being confirmed — but 100% needs all 15 of his Target Decks anyway, so the trophy lands along the way. He gives the unique Killtelligence SM-69 rifle during the first quest (retrieve it from any Ammu-Nation locker); clean one-shot kills pay more but aren't required.
steps: As Jason, answer Bret's text after Coffee Break (Ch2).
Complete Veteran Hunted; pick up the Killtelligence SM-69 from an Ammu-Nation locker.
Work his Target Deck hunts (Map > Activities > Target Deck) — all 15 for 100%.

sources.label: PowerPyx — Trophy Guide & Roadmap
sources.note: Bret Vogel, 15 decks, rifle, unconfirmed animal

trophies.name: Don't Touch My Deck
trophies.guide: Complete any 3 of the 18 collectible card sets. Progress shows in the Collections section of the Progress menu; the 100% checklist wants 15 of 18 sets, so this silver lands early in the cleanup.
steps: Collect cards as you explore; check Progress > Collections for set progress.
Finish any three sets.
Keep going to 15 sets for 100%.

trophies.name: You WAiNKer!
trophies.guide: Scan any 100 environmental WAiNK locations — landmarks (31), curiosities (35), sculptures (23) and No Flusher graffiti tags all count, and there are more than 100 total. Hold Up to pull out the phone, R1 to scan. Vehicle scans are a separate objective (Whip It Good).
steps: Hold Up + R1 near landmarks, oddities, sculptures or No Flusher tags.
Any 100 distinct locations count — sweep beach strips and city blocks.
The trophy pops at 100; the 100% checklist wants the same 100.

trophies.name: One Last Thing
trophies.guide: Complete any 50 of the 80 challenges. Many fall naturally while you work other trophies; 100% needs 70 of 80, so you can skip the ten nastiest. Track under Progress > Challenges (the Completed checkmark).
steps: Let challenges accumulate during normal play.
Check Progress > Challenges for what's left.
Pick the easiest remaining ones to reach 50 (then 70 for 100%).

trophies.name: Hot Together
trophies.description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
trophies.guide: From Coffee Break (Chapter 2) you can free-roam as a duo: call your partner (hold Right, press Triangle), cause carnage to 4 stars, then escape the red heat zone together — leaving the flashing search area alone isn't enough. PowerPyx's favourite escape is the train tunnel north of Ambrosia in Kelly County: cops struggle on the tracks and the helicopter loses sight. You'll likely earn it automatically during bank-vault robberies, which always trigger 4 stars.
steps: After Coffee Break, call your partner.
Reach a 4-star wanted level (a bank vault does it instantly).
Escape the red heat zone — the Ambrosia train tunnel is the easy route.

sources.label: PowerPyx — Trophy Guide & Roadmap
sources.note: duo unlock, tunnel escape, heat zone rule

trophies.name: Retail Therapy
trophies.description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
trophies.guide: With your partner along (after Coffee Break), rob 3 shops back-to-back while keeping the red/blue wanted level active the whole time — sitting in the heat zone without an active pursuit doesn't count. The three jewelry stores in north Vice City (open after Yasmani's Jewelry Jobs, Chapter 3) are the classic route: loot a few items in each, crack the back-room safe with sticky bombs, keep moving. The unlock is delayed ~30 seconds after the third store; if it doesn't pop, hit a fourth.
steps: Bring armored vests, sticky bombs and Zombix/Adrenaline; call your partner.
Rob three shops in a row without losing the wanted level (north Vice City jewelry trio works).
Wait ~30 seconds after the third store; hit a fourth if needed.

trophies.name: Whip It Good
trophies.guide: Discover 100 distinct vehicles by scanning them with WAiNK (hold Up, then R1) — no need to drive or steal them. Stand by a busy road and scan traffic; boats and aircraft count too. 557 vehicles exist at launch; the 100% checklist wants 200 of the 277 base models scanned, so the trophy comes naturally. Check totals under Progress > Vehicles.
steps: Scan every new vehicle you see from Chapter 1 onward.
Camp a busy road to fill gaps quickly.
At 100 discoveries the trophy pops; keep scanning toward 200 base models for 100%.

trophies.name: Gunslinger
trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
trophies.guide: Take down 5 enemies within one Combat Focus activation (L3+R3 while aiming). Focus lasts seconds, so prepare: buff it with food/drink or a shower at home, carry Adrenaline to extend it, wear body armor, and use a full-auto assault rifle like the Duke 556. Gang members at illegal operations are the best targets — PowerPyx notes it doesn't seem to work on soldiers, police or civilians. Focus has 4 levels; ranges, golf, pool and fishing raise it.
steps: Buff Focus (food/shower), equip Adrenaline, body armor and an assault rifle.
Line up 5 gang enemies at an illegal operation.
Activate Combat Focus (L3+R3) and drop all 5 before the bar drains.

trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can
trophies.description: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
trophies.guide: Steal a large passenger jet docked at a boarding bridge at VCIA — airfield-parked planes don't count. The easiest is at departure terminals E3/E4: drive through an airfield fence, take the stairs beside the bridge into the plane, go upstairs to the cockpit, reverse to the runway and take off. The unlock is delayed until you're about 1 km from the airport.
steps: Head to VCIA terminals E3/E4 (or walk in through the terminal).
Board the docked airliner, reach the cockpit, push back and take off.
Fly ~1 km away; the trophy pops.

trophies.name: Challenging Tank
trophies.guide: Steal a Rhino tank at Mile Zero Air Station on the south-west island in Mariana County — the tanks park at the south end of the base. Drive through the gate (or use the stunt jump by the south-east entrance), hop in a tank and shoot enemies until it pops.
steps: Reach Mile Zero Air Station (south-west Mariana County).
Enter the base and take a tank from the south end.
Fire on enemies until the trophy unlocks.

trophies.name: Sneakthief
trophies.description: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
trophies.guide: Rob a jewelry store without detection. Finish Yasmani's Jewelry Jobs (Chapter 3) to get the Snap Gun, which silently lockpicks alarmed doors — kicking triggers the alarm. Use it on a store's back door, find the safe-code note in the storeroom and open the safe quietly. Richardson Jewelry & Diamonds in Vice City is a good target; stores mark green on unfogged map areas.
steps: Complete Yasmani's Jewelry Jobs in Chapter 3 (unlocks Snap Gun + jewelry robberies).
Approach a store's back door and choose the Snap Gun, not kick.
Find the safe-code note inside and loot the safe undetected.

sources.label: PowerPyx — Trophy Guide & Roadmap
sources.note: Snap Gun, back door, safe note

trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal
trophies.guide: Rob 5 of the 8 large bank vaults and escape. Vaults unlock via the Chapter 4 optional mission That's Where The Money Is…: tail the security van to the bank and enter while the guard holds the vault open. Bring your partner — you can't carry all the cash bags alone. Every vault triggers 4 stars (feeding Hot Together); escape the red heat zone or use a Pay 'n' Spray. Up to $205,000 per bank; 100% needs all 8.
steps: Complete That's Where The Money Is… (Ch4 optional).
Tail the armored van; enter the vault while the guard has it open.
Loot with your partner and escape the heat — repeat at 5 banks (8 for 100%).

trophies.name: A Classic Blitz Play
trophies.description: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.
trophies.guide: Rob an armored truck and escape. PowerPyx notes a large bank-vault robbery counts too (you tail the armored truck to the bank): grab the cash and escape the red heat radius, or respray at a Pay 'n' Spray. A sticky bomb on a truck also works.
steps: Find an armored truck (or run a bank vault job, which tails one).
Rob it — sticky bombs are the quick way.
Escape the heat zone or respray.

trophies.name: The Goodtime State
trophies.guide: Explore all of Leonida — clear the fog from the entire map; PSN tracks 52 areas. The fastest sweep is by plane: fly the coastline and an inland grid once, then fill gaps by road or boat.
steps: Fly a plane over the whole map to clear fog fast.
Check the tracker for remaining areas; sweep by road/boat.
At full exploration the trophy pops.

trophies.name: Pest Control
trophies.description: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang.
trophies.guide: Rob one illegal operation belonging to each of the 9 gangs (39 operations exist). The trophy needs one per gang, while 100% demands all 39 — so this bronze lands early in the robbery sweep. Gang enemies are also the best Gunslinger targets.
steps: Open the map's robbery layer and note each gang's operations.
Rob at least one per gang (9 gangs).
Continue to all 39 for the 100% checklist.

trophies.name: In The Beginning…
trophies.description: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.
trophies.guide: A cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach — the exact trigger is still unconfirmed. PowerPyx listed it unknown at launch and gtaculture found no published method; pro-gamer.gg reports ordering and enjoying a drink overlooking the Ocean Beach strip (a nod to Vice City's opening), but nobody we checked has verified it. Try beachfront bars around Ocean Beach and treat any specific spot as unverified.
steps: Head to the Ocean Beach strip in Vice City.
Look for a bar or cocktail spot with a beach view (reported, unverified).
Order and enjoy the drink; if nothing pops, the trigger is still unknown — check guide updates.

trophies.name: Capital Offense
trophies.description: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style.
trophies.guide: Smash out of a vehicle showroom in classic style. PowerPyx's guide says it must be a specific blue Banshee driven through the showroom's display window — a GTA III Banshee callback — not just any car. The exact showroom isn't pinned down in the sources we read, and other trackers still list the trigger as unknown, so treat the location as unconfirmed.
steps: Locate a vehicle showroom displaying a blue Banshee (location unconfirmed — check PowerPyx updates).
Steal that specific car.
Drive it through the showroom's display window.

sources.label: PowerPyx — Trophy Guide & Roadmap
sources.note: blue Banshee requirement, GTA III nod

trophies.name: Let’s Go Bowling
trophies.description: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley.
trophies.guide: Despite the description naming Kolt & Associates, the guides agree the job is at Kingpin Bowling, a gang operation in Port Gellhorn: steal all three key valuables — the luxury watch in the south-east office, the unique Gutterball Moreland 850 shotgun on the north-east table, and the safe in the north-east hallway office (sticky bombs work) — then lose the police. Previously collected valuables still count if you return later. gta.guide flags the name mismatch honestly.
steps: Hit Kingpin Bowling in Port Gellhorn (gang operation).
Take the watch (SE office), the Gutterball Moreland 850 (NE table) and the safe (NE hallway office).
Escape the police.

trophies.name: Personal Best
trophies.guide: Max out Strength for both Jason and Lucia. The trick: visit fitness clubs together — while one character works out, the partner trains automatically, so progress doubles. Call your partner before hitting the gym.
steps: Call your partner to join you.
Work out at fitness clubs; both characters gain Strength.
Max both Strength bars.

trophies.name: Actions Speak Louder
trophies.guide: Perform 500 actions that shift your Criminal Profile — robberies and enemy encounters count, so most players earn it passively. Turn on the profile UI notifications to watch it. Avoid pushing the profile to Irredeemable: it's permanent and makes police more aggressive. If it hasn't popped by the end, any profile-affecting action farms it quickly.
steps: Enable Criminal Profile notifications in settings.
Play normally — robberies and encounters accumulate actions.
At 500 the trophy pops; keep the profile below Irredeemable.

trophies.name: Bad Luck, I Guess
trophies.guide: 'Second time's the charm' — the trigger is undisclosed. PowerPyx and gtaculture list it unknown; pro-gamer.gg reads it as a nod to Lucia's Trailer 1 line, unlocked by succeeding on a second attempt, but that is a theory, not a verified method. Retry failed attempts a second time and watch for the pop; no source confirms a specific spot.
steps: When an activity or attempt fails, try it again immediately (reported theory).
Keep playing normally; the trigger is unconfirmed.
Check guide updates — PowerPyx still lists it unknown.

trophies.name: The Truth Is Out There
trophies.guide: Almost certainly the UFO encounter. GamesHorizon published the first walkthrough (Nov 19): from Chapter 2, drive the rural roads east of Port Gellhorn in Kelly County at night — most reliably after 2 AM — a few hundred metres from the Starlet Motel safehouse. Find a parked car facing a woodland trail, trunk open, lights flickering, clothes scattered; follow the trail with your flashlight to a misty clearing where a UFO beams someone up. Talk to them, offer help, fetch their car — as you reach it the UFO returns overhead and the trophy pops (you wake up three days later). Works as Jason or Lucia. PowerPyx still lists it unknown and suspects a UFO questline; these steps are reported, not yet verified by the trackers we cite.
steps: From Chapter 2, go to the roads east of Port Gellhorn near the Starlet Motel after 2 AM.
Find the abandoned car (open trunk, flickering lights); follow the trail toward the blue glow.
In the clearing, talk to the person under the UFO; offer help and agree to fetch the car.
Walk back to the car — the UFO beams you up and the trophy unlocks.

trophies.name: Ten Pin
trophies.description: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by.
trophies.guide: A melee drive-by — knock someone over with a melee attack from a moving vehicle. The exact trigger (how many targets, which weapon) is unconfirmed: PowerPyx lists it unknown, pro-gamer.gg reports knocking down multiple targets in a row. Try swinging a bat at pedestrians from a slowly moving car; treat specifics as unverified.
steps: Equip a melee weapon and drive slowly past targets (reported).
Swing from the moving vehicle — multiple knockdowns may be needed (unconfirmed).
Check guide updates for the verified trigger.

trophies.name: Dime on the Dollar
trophies.description: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.
trophies.guide: Launder $250,000 in marked bills through fences, cumulative across all robberies. The Dye Pack Jammer comes from the Chapter 3 main mission Credit Check (Meet Raul's Crew); after that, banks and Payday Loans yield marked bills — sell them to fences, and Yasmani in Vice City pays the most. Bank vaults (up to $205k a run, unlocked Ch4) make this fall naturally during the 100% robbery sweep.
steps: Complete Credit Check in Chapter 3 to unlock the Dye Pack Jammer.
Rob banks and Payday Loans; keep the marked bills.
Sell to fences (Yasmani pays best) until $250,000 total is laundered.

trophies.name: Treat Yo Self
trophies.guide: Spend $100,000 across all shops, cumulative. Weapons, vehicle customization and tattoos burn money fastest; the world also has 18 hair & beauty salons, 11 tattoo studios and 15 electronics stores. Reserve the $160,000 for Little Boxes' garages first if cash is tight.
steps: Buy weapons, mods and tattoos as you play.
Track spending toward $100,000 across any shops.
The trophy pops at $100k total.

trophies.name: Little Boxes
trophies.guide: Buy all 8 purchasable garages (~$160,000 total) through the Vice City Real Estate phone app, which installs after Daily Driver (Chapter 2). The 4 story garages don't count. Garage space also feeds On the Spot's registrations. Robberies in Chapters 3–4 fund it quickly.
steps: Complete Daily Driver in Chapter 2 to get the real estate app.
Buy all 8 garages through the app (~$160k).
The trophy pops with the eighth purchase.

trophies.name: On the Spot
trophies.description: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
trophies.guide: Register 10 vehicles in the Scooter Bros app, installed after the Chapter 2 mission Moses: take eligible stolen cars to his garage in Port Gellhorn, choose Respray then Register. You need free garage space (see Little Boxes) and each registration costs money — cheap cars and bikes keep it down. Initially only tracker-free vehicles qualify; later in Chapter 3, Standard Tracker cars and Pay 'n' Spray registration open up. Registered vehicles can be summoned anywhere.
steps: Complete Moses (Ch2) to install Scooter Bros.
Own enough garage space; steal cheap cars/bikes.
Deliver to Moses in Port Gellhorn, Respray → Register — repeat 10 times.
